name: The Darkmoon Faire
label: Quest
description: The Darkmoon Faire: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Darkmoon Faire is coming! Be sure to experience all the wonders and excitement of it when it comes to town!
If you act right now, you can redeem this voucher for free prize tickets! Just hand your voucher to Gelvas Grimgate located inside the carnival.
Right now, the Faire is outside Goldshire, in the Elwynn Forest. Don't miss out! Go today!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Yes friend, may I help you? Do you have a voucher that needs redeeming?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Welcome to the Darkmoon Faire! This voucher is good for FIVE, yes, FIVE prize tickets!
When you accumulate prize tickets, you'll want to speak to me about redeeming them for valuable prizes. The more tickets you get, the more prizes you can win. Huzzah!
